title: Word RAM simulation time
statement: For natural numbers $A,n,W,t,f$ and a function $T_W : \bbn \to \bbn$, define the simulation time to be $T_W(n)+A(t+1)\bigl(f(W+1)+W^2+n+1\bigr)$.
